title: Observation of the influence of dipolar and spin frustration effects on the magnetocaloric properties of a trigonal prismatic {Gd7} molecular nanomagnet

material_class.structural_family: trigonal-prismatic {Gd7} cage of three vertex-sharing {Gd3(μ3-OH)} triangles

synthesis.procedure: Compound 1 was synthesized by refluxing [Gd2(O2CtBu)6(HO2CtBu)6] (0.469 g, 3 mmol) and diisopropylamine (iPr2NH) (0.3 mL, 2.0 mmol) in acetonitrile (20 mL) for 3 h. The solution was filtered and left undisturbed at about 5 °C for about one week. Hexagonal colorless crystals suitable for X-ray diffraction were collected. Elemental analysis was obtained after drying at 80 °C for about 12 h, which removes lattice MeCN; the dried composition is given as Gd7N6O45C102H204. The main text only states that 1 is obtained from [Gd2(O2CtBu)6(HO2CtBu)6] and iPr2NH in MeCN and refers the procedure to the ESI.
synthesis.time: 3 h reflux, then about one week
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The solution was filtered and left undisturbed at about 5 °C for about one week to give hexagonal colorless crystals. Several crystals gave identical unit cells. For elemental analysis the sample was dried at 80 °C for about 12 h, losing lattice MeCN.

properties.summary: Compound 1 is a weakly coupled, geometrically frustrated homometallic Gd7 cluster studied as a cryogenic magnetocaloric refrigerant. χMT is near the free-ion value down to about 10 K and then falls; magnetization saturates near 49 μB. Indirect MCE analysis gives −ΔSm = 30.8 J kg−1 K−1 at 2.1 K for ΔB0 = 7 T (83% of the full spin entropy). Isotropic exchanges are very weak (J1 = J2 = −0.02 cm−1, J3 = 0) and comparable to intramolecular dipolar couplings, which rearrange states below about 2 K, smear frustration signatures in the isentropes, and limit the lowest temperatures reached. Direct adiabatic demagnetization cools below 100 mK, with an example from 0.6 K at 1.5 T to Tad = 0.13 K.

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: room temperature, B0 = 0.1 T; calculated 55.1 emu K mol−1 for seven non-interacting s = 7/2, g = 2.00

measurements.name: χMT
measurements.conditions: 2 K, B0 = 0.1 T; χMT constant to about 10 K then drops sharply

measurements.name: saturation magnetization
measurements.conditions: 7 T, 2 K; full polarization limit 49.0 μB for seven s = 7/2, g = 2.00

measurements.name: magnetization plateau
measurements.conditions: about 0.3–0.6 T; metastable configuration assigned as outer Gd spins aligned against the central Gd (S = 35/2)

measurements.name: lattice specific-heat coefficient C/T^3
measurements.conditions: Debye lattice contribution at the lowest temperatures; C lattice-dominated above about 5 K

measurements.name: −ΔSm
measurements.conditions: maximum at 2.1 K for ΔB0 = (7 − 0) T, from C(B0,T) and M(B0,T)

measurements.name: full magnetic entropy Sm
measurements.conditions: nR ln(2s+1) with n = 7, s = 7/2; reached in zero field above about 3 K; 30.8 is 83% of this value

measurements.name: exchange coupling J1
measurements.conditions: best fit of χMT(T) and M(B0) to Heisenberg model; J1 between central Gd and all others; g = 2.00

measurements.name: exchange coupling J2
measurements.conditions: edges between triangular faces of the trigonal prism; g = 2.00

measurements.name: exchange coupling J3
measurements.conditions: edges of the triangular faces; g = 2.00

measurements.name: intramolecular dipolar tensor element magnitude
measurements.conditions: shortest Gd···Gd contacts, edges between triangular faces

measurements.name: effective internal field Beff
measurements.conditions: fictitious field used to mimic dipolar broadening of C(T) at B0 = 0

measurements.name: effective internal field Beff
measurements.conditions: at applied B0 = 1 T; not required at larger applied fields

measurements.name: adiabatic temperature Tad
measurements.conditions: direct quasi-adiabatic demagnetization from B0 = 1.5 T and T0 = 0.6 K (ESI example T0 = 0.58 K); temperatures below 100 mK are also reported

measurements.name: nearest ground-state total spins
measurements.conditions: Heisenberg model with the fitted J values: lowest eigenstates S = 13/2, 11/2 and 15/2 lie within 0.005 cm−1
